heating.title: Floor heating control
heating.description: Adjusts the heating water setpoint from an outdoor-temperature curve, nudged by the indoor temperature. It starts in advisory mode: it shows the setpoint it would use but only changes the pump once you turn on its "Write to pump" switch.

data_description.heating_curve_cold_outdoor: At or below this outdoor temperature the curve asks for the cold-point water temperature, for a 21 °C room.
data_description.heating_curve_mild_outdoor: At or above this one it asks for the mild-point water temperature. In between it is a straight line.
data_description.heating_max_flow: The setpoint is never set above this. For underfloor heating, keep it within your floor's limit.
data_description.heating_kp: Degrees of water added per degree the room is below target.
data_description.heating_ki: How fast a lasting room error is learned into the curve, per hour. 0 stops learning.
data_description.heating_outdoor_smoothing_hours: Averages the outdoor temperature over this time. 0 turns averaging off.
data_description.heating_manual_pause_hours: After the setpoint is changed on the pump or in an app, control waits this long.
data_description.heating_weather_entity: Hourly forecast to look ahead with. Leave empty to work without a forecast.
data_description.heating_lookahead_hours: The curve uses the average of now and the forecast for this many hours ahead, as the floor reacts hours late. 0 turns look-ahead off.
data_description.heating_sun_cut_max: How far to lower the water when the forecast shows full sun a few hours ahead, so the floor isn't full of heat when the sun arrives. 0 turns it off.
